segments.text: Episode twenty-six. Next stop... a planet where it rains iron.
Welcome to season two: the strangest worlds ever found. First, WASP seventy-six b, about six hundred forty light-years away.
segments.headline: Season 2: strange worlds

segments.text: One side always faces its star. It's so hot there that iron turns into vapor.
segments.headline: Iron turns to vapor

segments.text: On the day side, temperatures climb above two thousand four hundred degrees Celsius.
Winds carry that iron vapor to the cooler night side, where it condenses, and falls as iron rain.
segments.headline: It rains iron

segments.text: And a year there lasts less than two Earth days.
Tomorrow, an even more violent world. Next stop: a blue planet where it rains glass sideways. Follow, so you don't miss episode twenty-seven.
